title: Witch with Mystic Cauldron
description: A green-skinned witch in a black hooded robe holds a large black cauldron filled with glowing orbs. A green dragon is draped across her shoulders while a cascade of green magical liquid, crystals, and floating gems pours downward from above into the cauldron.
prompt: A green-skinned witch wearing a black hooded starry robe holds a large black cauldron overflowing with glowing green and red crystal orbs and liquid. A green dragon rests on her shoulders. Streams of green magical energy, diamonds, and gems cascade from above into the cauldron against a purple and green cosmic background with floating particles.
